topics.name: Agent safeguards tailored to the task
topics.summary: Generate and evaluate protective rules and executable checks for a particular agent deployment.
topics.why_now: OpenAI published a standing framework for tracking, investigating and disclosing observed model misalignment, adding a new primary development to the broader move from static safeguards toward runtime evidence and response.
topics.practical_value: Could improve how training materials explain agent permissions, checks and deployment-specific evaluation.
topics.limitations: A preprint and its benchmarks do not establish protection against all real-world attacks.
topics.next_action: Compare containment failures and goal-conflict evaluations, then extract reusable sandbox, monitoring and approval tests.

topics.name: Turning agent memory into compact plans
topics.summary: Use remembered episodes when planning, then give the executor a compact plan instead of the full history.
topics.why_now: MaP-WAM studies this separation in memory-dependent robotic tasks.
topics.practical_value: A possible teaching example for separating memory, planning and execution; transfer to office agents remains unproven.
topics.limitations: Robotics results cannot be assumed to apply to general knowledge-work agents.
topics.next_action: Check the experimental setup and search for independent applications outside robotics.
